from support import *
from selenium import webdriver
from selenium.webdriver.common.by import By
from selenium.webdriver.support.ui import WebDriverWait
from selenium.webdriver.support import expected_conditions as EC
from selenium.webdriver.chrome.service import Service
root=Path('test-data/browser-'+str(time.time_ns()));root.mkdir(parents=True);download=root/'downloads';download.mkdir()
f=root/'browser.bin';f.write_bytes(bytes(range(256))*16)
with Server(root/'data') as s:
 opts=webdriver.ChromeOptions();opts.binary_location='/usr/bin/chromium'
 for flag in ['--headless=new','--no-sandbox','--disable-dev-shm-usage']:opts.add_argument(flag)
 opts.add_experimental_option('prefs',{'download.default_directory':str(download.resolve()),'download.prompt_for_download':False})
 driver=webdriver.Chrome(service=Service('/usr/bin/chromedriver'),options=opts);driver.set_page_load_timeout(10);driver.set_script_timeout(10)
 try:
  wait=WebDriverWait(driver,10);driver.get(s.base)
  driver.find_element(By.ID,'repo-name').send_keys('browser');driver.find_element(By.ID,'repo-description').send_keys('Created through Chromium')
  driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR,'#repo-form button').click();wait.until(lambda d:'Created browser' in d.find_element(By.ID,'status').text)
  driver.find_element(By.ID,'artifact-name').send_keys('widget');driver.find_element(By.ID,'artifact-version').send_keys('opaque-v1');driver.find_element(By.ID,'artifact-file').send_keys(str(f.resolve()))
  driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR,'#upload-form button').click();wait.until(lambda d:'Uploaded immutable version' in d.find_element(By.ID,'status').text)
  assert 'widget / opaque-v1' in driver.find_element(By.ID,'versions').text
  driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR,'#versions button').click();wait.until(lambda d:'sha256' in d.find_element(By.ID,'metadata').text)
  driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR,'#versions a').click()
  deadline=time.monotonic()+10
  while time.monotonic()<deadline and not (download/'widget-opaque-v1').exists():time.sleep(.05)
  assert identity(download/'widget-opaque-v1')==identity(f)
  driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR,'#upload-form button').click();wait.until(lambda d:'409' in d.find_element(By.ID,'status').text)
  driver.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR,'#versions button')[1].click();wait.until(EC.alert_is_present());driver.switch_to.alert.accept();wait.until(lambda d:'Deleted widget' in d.find_element(By.ID,'status').text)
  assert not driver.find_element(By.ID,'versions').text
  driver.save_screenshot(str(root/'browser.png'))
  print(json.dumps({'browser':'passed','created':True,'uploaded':True,'metadata':True,'download':identity(f),'conflict':409,'confirmed_delete':True,'data':str(root)}))
 finally:driver.quit()

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, random, shutil
root = Path("fixtures")
root.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
(root / "empty.bin").write_bytes(b"")
(root / "text.txt").write_bytes(b"Depot fixture v1\n")
(root / "binary.bin").write_bytes(bytes(range(256)) * 16)
(root / "nested/input/deep").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
(root / "nested/input/deep/object.bin").write_bytes(bytes(range(256)) * 16)
(root / "small").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
for i in range(64):
    (root / "small" / f"item-{i:03}.bin").write_bytes(hashlib.sha256(f"small:{i}".encode()).digest() * 8)
rng = random.Random(337)
with (root / "large-v1.bin").open("wb") as stream:
    for _ in range(512):
        stream.write(rng.randbytes(65536))
shutil.copyfile(root / "large-v1.bin", root / "large-identical.bin")
shutil.copyfile(root / "large-v1.bin", root / "large-v2.bin")
with (root / "large-v2.bin").open("r+b") as stream:
    stream.seek(1048583)
    old = stream.read(1)
    stream.seek(1048583)
    stream.write(bytes([old[0] ^ 255]))

from support import *
import socket

f=root/'acknowledged.bin';f.write_bytes(b'acknowledged complete bytes');expected=identity(f)
with Server(root/'data') as s:
 s.json('POST','/api/repos',{'name':'recovery'},201);s.put(artifact('recovery','keep','v1'),f)
 c=socket.create_connection((s.host,int(s.port)),timeout=5)
 c.sendall(b'PUT /api/repos/recovery/artifacts/interrupted/v1 HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: localhost\r\nContent-Length: 1000000\r\n\r\n'+b'x'*65536);c.close()
 assert s.request('GET',artifact('recovery','interrupted','v1'))[0]==404
 assert s.request('GET',artifact('recovery','interrupted','v1')+'/download')[0]==404
with Server(root/'data','after_rename') as s:
 try:s.put(artifact('recovery','failed','fault'),f);raise AssertionError('fault did not terminate')
 except (http.client.RemoteDisconnected,ConnectionResetError):pass
 assert s.p.wait(timeout=5)==86
with Server(root/'data') as s:
 assert s.request('GET',artifact('recovery','failed','fault'))[0]==404
 assert s.request('GET',artifact('recovery','interrupted','v1'))[0]==404
 s.download(artifact('recovery','keep','v1'),expected)
 assert not list((root/'data/tmp').iterdir())
 s.put(artifact('recovery','pending','fault-delete'),f)
with Server(root/'data','delete_mark') as s:
 try:s.request('DELETE',artifact('recovery','pending','fault-delete'));raise AssertionError('delete fault did not terminate')
 except (http.client.RemoteDisconnected,ConnectionResetError):pass
 assert s.p.wait(timeout=5)==87
with Server(root/'data') as s:
 assert s.request('GET',artifact('recovery','pending','fault-delete'))[0]==404
 s.download(artifact('recovery','keep','v1'),expected)
 assert not (root/'data/objects/recovery/pending/fault-delete').exists()
 print(json.dumps({'recovery':'passed','interrupted':'not visible','publication_fault_exit':86,'deletion_fault_exit':87,'preserved':expected,'data':str(root)}))
